subject: Issue with RStan code running non-interactively on HPC cluster

messages.author: bacb0402e67daa77
messages.subject: Issue with RStan code running non-interactively on HPC cluster
parts:
Hi All,

I've tested my code to work fine on my on computer and on interactive nodes of an HPC cluster. However, when I schedule my RStan code to run non-interactively on an HPC environment, I repeatedly get a related error message along the lines of:


Loading required package: StanHeaders
rstan (Version 2.12.1, packaged: 2016-09-11 13:07:50 UTC, GitRev: 85f7a56811da)
For execution on a local, multicore CPU with excess RAM we recommend calling
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
Error in file(con, "r") : cannot open the connection
Calls: stan ... cxxfunctionplus -> cxxfunction -> compileCode -> readLines -> file
In addition: Warning messages:
1: running command '/data/apps/R/3.2.3/lib64/R/bin/R CMD SHLIB file66140ff794a.cpp 2> file66140ff794a.cpp.err.txt' had status 1
2: In file(con, "r") :
  cannot open file 'file66140ff794a.cpp.err.txt': No such file or directory

I think this has to do with the temporary files that Stan writes and that there is some folder that Stan does not have access to? I am just mystified because my code runs without issue again on my computer and interactively on the HPC. Has anybody had a similar issue running their code non-interactively on an HPC cluster?

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Issue with RStan code running non-interactively on HPC cluster
parts:
On Tuesday, November 15, 2016 at 5:34:41 PM UTC-5, H. X. wrote:
Very strangely, the code works when I run it interactively from the login node, not something I am supposed to do, of course.

This sounds more like a cluster problem than a Stan problem. One thing that may work for you would be to do on the login node

rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
sm <- stan_model("path/to/AWB_adriana.stan")
q()

which will write a AWB_adriana.rda file in the same directory as the AWB_adriana.stan file. Then when you do MCMC on the child nodes, they should automatically load the model from AWB_adriana.rda without recompiling it.

Ben
